substrate_implementations.S32: IEEE754 single rounding of every stored state each step
substrate_implementations.S16: IEEE754 half rounding of every stored state each step
substrate_implementations.S_Q15: 16-bit signed fixed point; add/mul in Q15 each step; transcendentals via documented float fallback
substrate_implementations.S_FSM: 13-state lattice snap every step (state count hidden from detector)
substrate_implementations.S_MOD: Z_100003 residue-ring recurrence with x1000 integer coefficients (constants versioned in source)
substrate_implementations.S_HASH_NATIVE: SplitMix64 chain term added INSIDE each recurrence step (0.05*u_hash)
substrate_implementations.S_UNKNOWN: top-2-mantissa-bit truncation of every state (novel; never trained on)
